column1: # Evidence-based names manifest: docs/names/METHOD.md. Applied and reverted by tools/rename.py.

# Columns: address, kind (class|function|global), old, new, confidence (high|med|low: the honest evidence grade), apply (yes|no: whether tools/rename.py applies the row; low rows are applied by owner decision 2026-11-05, see METHOD.md and LOW_CONFIDENCE.md), evidence.

column7: evidence

The game's sound system object: its constructor fn_8045A080 (game/tu_80457DFC.cpp) is the only writer of lbl_8053AF80 and its unit calls JAISeMgr::setCategoryArrangement / setSeqDataMgr, JAUSectionHeap::setSeqDataArchive / newDynamicSeqBlock, JAUSection::loadWaveArc, JASDriver::setOutputMode, JASDsp::setFXLine, JASAudioReseter::start (dtk asm, bl targets); same role as TP's Z2AudioMgr (zeldaret/tp include/Z2AudioLib/Z2AudioMgr.h), name not proven; named after its constructor

include/game/Map.h: the object at lbl_8053AB10->0x20 holds the screen's tile layers (u16 tile codes on a 32x32 grid, fn_802F9908 / fn_802F9974) and draws the "SOB " sprites; BgRewrite_804A7C98 writes tile codes into it; vtable 0x804AA858

include/game/GameGlobals.h + DrawShadow.h: constructor 0x801594E8 loads "circle.bti" into a JUTTexture; fn_80158B5C draws it under actors (18 units compute layer/pos, colour, scale first); vtable 0x804A0160

include/game/cls_804A6A00.h: the shared base of the minor Shadow Link actors (act_shadow_link_jump, act_shadow_link_bow; actors.tsv SLK2/BBSL family "Shadow Link", msg#317); constructor fn_802218C8 calls EnemyBase's and stores vtable 0x804A6A00

include/game/cls_804B1378.h: the screen that loads "bat_stage_select.blo" (string in game/tu_80414F6C.cpp's data, referenced by its constructor) and "kk_kettei_01.bti" / "kk_modoru_01.bti" (decide / back buttons); vtable 0x804B1378

include/game/tu_803F0A54.h: built by cls_804AF878's constructor only when lbl_8053AAF8->field_0x7f (single-player) is clear; counts the connected controllers (fn_8030A308 per player input slot) into lbl_8053AAF8->field_0x82; vtable 0x804B0F10

include/game/GameState.h: a J2DPane and its box (0x2C bytes); fn_80402F04 stores the pane with its bounds and centre, fn_80402E08 moves it relative to its centre, fn_804023D0 sets its alpha (vtable slot 0x24); 28 units allocate it next to J2DScreen::search; vtable 0x804AF86C

include/game/GameGlobals.h: `extern GameRoot_8049EF20* lbl_8053AAF8`, the GameRoot object pointer (.sbss, 4 bytes); DEMOTED (adversarial review 2026-11-05): "GameRoot"/"GameRoot2" only echo the provisional type name and say nothing about the role (GameRoot2 holds draw buffers, ortho graphs, map, camera, effects, shadow); the address name is more honest until the role is named

include/game/BgRewrite.h: only BgRewrite_804A7C98's constructor and destructor store it
include/game/GameGlobals.h: fn_8045A080 (AudioMgr_8045A080 constructor) initialises the object and stores it here
include/game/Player.h: `extern PlayerManager_804A6F28* lbl_8053AC90`; the per-player forwarders of tu_8022AD64 test it for NULL
include/game/Effect.h: spawns effect `id` at pos on a layer and returns its JPABaseEmitter (JPAEmitterManager::createSimpleEmitterID path), 224 units / 1866 calls
include/game/Effect.h: returns lbl_8053AB10->0x28, the EffectSystem_8049F178 ("reach it with fn_8013C824()"); 0xC bytes
include/game/Effect.h: moves a non-NULL emitter to pos (lifted by height/depth, z from the ground under pos) and stores it in the emitter's translation 0xA4-0xAC; 66 units
include/game/GameView.h: `extern "C" GameView_804A9950* fn_802D6A9C(void)`, "reach it with fn_802D6A9C()"; 275 game units
include/game/ActorManager.h: the live actor with mSerial == serial or NULL (tries mActors[mLastSlot] first, then scans); 170 units / 709 calls

include/game/ActorManager.h + docs/names/README.md: the actor spawner, switch on the 4-character ActorId, constructs the actor, copies pos to mPos/mPrevPos/mSpawnPos, calls init() and returns the serial or -1; 145 units / 521 calls

include/game/ActorBase.h: starts sound `soundId` on the actor's ActorSoundObj_804578F4 (ActorManager_804A5800::fn_801F6644) through fn_80456334 with a fade time (JAISound::fadeIn path); 176 call sites
include/game/ActorBase.h: draws frame `frame` of the "SOB " sprite bank `name` at mPos on this actor's layer (fn_801EF830); 116 units / 193 calls

same body and signature as cLib_addCalc2(f32*, f32 target, f32 scale, f32 maxStep) in zeldaret/tww src/SSystem/SComponent/c_lib.cpp:56 (and tp c_lib.cpp:83); FSA has no SComponent library (it sits inside game/tu_801F6058.cpp), so the TWW name is not proven for FSA

same algorithm as cLib_addCalcAngleS2(s16*, s16 target, s16 scale, s16 maxStep) in zeldaret/tww src/SSystem/SComponent/c_lib.cpp:192 (delta = (target - *v) / scale, clamped to maxStep), here on u16; next to addCalc2_801F71A4
include/game/GameGlobals.h: maps a player index (0-3) to an input slot (-0x3E7 for none), game/tu_803099FC.cpp; 86 call sites
include/game/Message.h: copies the text of message `msg` (the BMG's INF1 entry) into out and returns its width from the font; 16 menu units / 196 calls
include/game/Camera.h: Camera_804AA9E4 member; appends pos to the queue of points the camera keeps in view (field_0x1f0, at most 0x80) when it lies in the visible area; 77 units
include/game/DrawShadow.h: draws ShadowCircle_804A0160's "circle.bti" at pos on a layer with a colour and scale (the drawShadow() wrapper)
include/game/GameState.h: PaneCtrl_804AF86C member; stores the pane, its position (getBounds), size, centre and alpha byte 0xB2; 28 units
include/game/GameState.h: PaneCtrl_804AF86C member; moves the pane (J2DPane::move, vtable 0x10) so its centre is field_0x10 + x, field_0x14 + y; 27 units
include/game/GameState.h: PaneCtrl_804AF86C member; calls the pane's setAlpha (vtable 0x24) with alpha * the stored alpha / field_0x28
include/game/Player.h: per-player query, returns the player's field_0x3b4 (the actor layer, ActorBase_804A5770::field_0x4 convention) or 0 when the player is missing; 134 units
include/game/SpriteAnim.h: SpriteAnim_801D267C member; starts animation `anim` in J3DFrameCtrl mode `mode`, length = sum of key durations; 54 units / 262 calls
include/game/Player.h: returns the player's &mPos, else &lbl_804CF460; 174 call sites
include/game/ActorManager.h: returns gGame->mStage->mActorMgr ("reach it with fn_801F856C()"); docs/PLAN.md baseline function
include/game/ActorBase.h: frees a JPABaseEmitter (clearStatus(Immortal)/becomeInvalidEmitter or forceDeleteEmitter), NULL-safe
